$comment: The Troupe Master: a secret boss fight (skong-core `enemy::grimm`). Art is the vanilla `Grimm Anim` library (+ `Flameball Anim` for his fireballs, `Grimm Flash Anim` for teleport flashes); his art faces left and is mirrored to face right, drawn at `art_scale` x the knight's scale. Every distance is in game units and measured from the knight (his ledge, or the ledge under him), never from a fixed arena: Grimm teleports beside / above him, dashes and dives at him, slashes along his ledge and uppercuts out of it, sends firebats at his height, raises flame pillars under his feet and spikes along his ledge, and at each `phases` threshold (fraction of `hp` left) roars and floats up to spray fireballs (balloon). Flames ignore windows. Every attack has a wind-up the knight can read. `size`: body [w, h]. `hp`: blows he takes (spells count more). `tempo`: speed multiplier for his whole routine. `invuln`: seconds the knight can't be hurt again after a hit. `geo`: [min, max] burst when beaten. `max_secs`: he bows out of a fight that drags on. Typing at least `busy_keys_per_sec` for `busy_secs`, a fullscreen app or a visitor make him bow out too (no penalty). `lantern`: how he is found. Once `min_achievements` are unlocked, a dim scarlet flame appears now and then (`schedule`, like npcs.json `visits`: presence time, never during fullscreen apps, fast typing, a visitor, a gauntlet, other enemies or a waiting Shade) on a settled ledge the knight can reach. The knight only lingers by it, wondering (a pastime); the user clicks it to summon Grimm, who steps out of it there (the arena is whatever the user built around it). It waits `secs` (long, time to arrange windows) and only a fullscreen app puts it out early. `cameo`: his rare friendly visit (`schedule` like `visits`; never during fullscreen apps, typing, visitors, fights, the Shade): a teleport flash and flourish, a bow, a `cameo` line, `hops` teleports around the knight, a `cameo_bye` line, gone; with `flame_chance` he leaves his scarlet flame behind, but only once `lantern.min_achievements` are unlocked.Lines: original writing only, `{daypart}` / `{app}` / `{title}` placeholders allowed (a line whose placeholder can't be filled is skipped).

intro: Ah. A small flame answered the call. Splendid.
You struck the lantern. Now we dance; it is only polite.
A stage of glass and light. How delightfully improvised.
Every desk deserves one performance. Let this be yours.
Take your bow, little vessel. The curtain rises this {daypart}.
Such a curious theatre. The {app} window will make a fine balcony.
phase2: Your windows make a curious stage. I adore it.
phase3: The final act! Hold nothing back.
Such fire in so small a shell!
Now the flames take their bow... or you do.
defeat: Magnificent. The troupe will speak of this desk.
A worthy finale. Keep the Geo; you earned the applause.
Ah... the lantern dims. Until the next performance.
triumph: A graceful fall. Rest, and rise for an encore.
Do not despair. Every great act begins with a stumble.
Your shadow lingers on the stage. Go and reclaim it.
bow_out: Ah, the house lights. We shall resume another night.
An intermission, then. Pardon my exit.
The stage is needed elsewhere. Adieu, for now.
cameo: Merely passing through, little vessel. A troupe must keep moving.
Do not trouble your nail. Tonight I only came to look at you.
What a charming little stage you keep. The {app} window has real potential.
No performance this {daypart}. Only a bow between artists.
cameo_bye: Until we meet in the light of a scarlet flame.
Keep dancing. I shall be watching.
Adieu. Do look for the flame, if it ever calls.
